meta.project: Tokyo Ravens - Vol.2 RAVEN'S NEST Production Pipeline
meta.visual_reference: Eight Bit anime adaptation (covers LN 1-9, includes Vol.2) used as the visual-design baseline for appearance anchors. LN-specific descriptions were NOT independently re-verified this session; all appearance anchors are tagged INFERRED (anime adaptation reference) unless noted.
meta.anchor_rule: Each character MUST carry >=5 visual anchors and >=3 behavioral anchors per pipeline Stage 3 spec.

tag_legend.HARD_CANON: Verified against source text / authoritative wiki.
tag_legend.INFERRED: Derived from anime adaptation reference or reasonable canon-consistent inference.
tag_legend.UNCERTAIN: Flagged; do not lock into art prompts without sign-off.

characters.name: Harutora Tsuchimikado
characters.role: Protagonist; Tsuchimikado branch-family son; Natsume's shikigami-to-be; transfers into Onmyo Academy.

visual_anchors.anchor: Black short hair, slightly messy
Dark Onmyo Academy uniform (gakuran-style) with family crest
Average height/build for a teen; unremarkable features
Often wears a distracted / unlucky expression; prone to comedic accidents
Red talisman ribbon gifted by Hokuto, kept as a memento
Carries a wooden sword / practice wand early (no real shikigami yet)

behavioral_anchors.anchor: Speech: informal, self-deprecating; calls himself 'Baka-tora' (Stupid Tiger); earnest and hotheaded
Emotional range: courageous and kind under pressure; dense about others' feelings; loyal to friends
Verbal tic: frequent 'gānbaru' (I'll do my best) despite poor results; apologetic
Does NOT use occult jargon fluently early; leans on others for theory

relationships.type: childhood friend / sworn to protect as shikigami

characters.name: Natsume Tsuchimikado
characters.role: Tsuchimikado main-family heir; presents male per clan tradition; Harutora's commander.

visual_anchors.anchor: Long light-blonde / silver hair, usually tied back while presenting male
Wears the male Academy uniform; carries herself with deliberate masculinity in public
Slender build; refined, composed features
Familiar raven-coat / Raven's Wing motif associated with the heir (later)
Subtle feminine tells (hidden) — used by adaptation for reveal beats
Often holds/references Hokuto (her shikigami medium)

behavioral_anchors.anchor: Speech: uses male-first-person + formal, authoritative register in public; cold/commanding
Emotional range: proud and stubborn; inner vulnerability about Harutora and her hidden self
Tone-calibration risk (CR-3): source paints her as manipulative/divisive — preserve as written, do not soften
Verbal tic: terse commands to Harutora ('Bakatora'); rare soft smiles in private

relationships.type: childhood friend / commands him as shikigami

characters.name: Touji Ato
characters.role: Harutora's childhood friend; half-ogre host; Academy classmate.

visual_anchors.anchor: Wears an eyepatch over one eye (seals his living-spirit ogre)
Tall, lean, casual posture; often hands in pockets
Dark hair; relaxed, slightly disheveled look
When ogre surfaces: eye glows / arm manifests oni traits (Vol.2 Ch.5 One-Armed Oni)
Standard Academy uniform worn loosely
Carries a talisman-restraining charm for his ogre

behavioral_anchors.anchor: Speech: laidback, dry wit; understated; few words, well-timed jabs
Emotional range: calm exterior; protective of Harutora; resigned about his ogre
Verbal tic: sardonic 'mendokusai' (what a pain); deadpan
Does not boast about power; steps in decisively when friends threatened

characters.name: Suzuka Dairenji
characters.role: Prodigy onmyouji; youngest of the Twelve Divine Generals; later Academy transfer (penalty).

visual_anchors.anchor: Twin-tail hairstyle; youthful, sharp features
Ornate/aristocratic onmyouji attire distinct from Academy uniform when in Agency mode
Small stature befitting age 14
Often paired with her shikigami Tsuchigumo (spider familiar)
Expressive, prideful body language; pouts when flustered
Later wears Academy uniform after transfer (Vol.3-4 arc)

behavioral_anchors.anchor: Speech: arrogant, imperious; uses high-handed honorifics; breaks into tsundere denial
Emotional range: harsh surface over fragile, kind interior shaped by parental experimentation
Verbal tic: 'kisama' / sharp retorts; 'i-it's not like I care!' tsunde-re beats
Deep magical-theory knowledge; lectures others condescendingly

characters.name: Kon
characters.role: Harutora's Gohou-type shikigami; fox-eared silver-fox spirit in miko clothing.

visual_anchors.anchor: Small stature; fox ears + fox tail
Silver-fox coloration; miko-style clothing (white/red)
Wields a short blade (wakizashi)
Initially invisible/inaudible to Harutora until his awareness awakens (Vol.2 Ch.2 Ears and Tail)
Expressive, large eyes; childlike proportions
Later reveals Hishamaru form (reserved — CR-2, NOT Vol.2)

behavioral_anchors.anchor: Speech: childlike, devoted; calls Harutora 'Harutora-sama'; possessive
Emotional range: fiercely loyal; jealous when Harutora nears other girls
Independent thought/action (rare Gohou-type); acts on own initiative to protect master
Verbal tic: '~na no!' (isn't it!) ; pouts when ignored

visual_anchors.anchor: Stylish Academy uniform worn with confidence
Friendly, open facial expression; heiress poise
Often at center of class socializing
Carries family-crest accessories
Bright color accent in outfit vs classmates

behavioral_anchors.anchor: Speech: upbeat, social, inclusive; natural leader of classroom mood
Emotional range: warm; occasionally sharp when family honor pressed
Verbal tic: enthusiastic agreements; mediates group tension

visual_anchors.anchor: Quiet, unobtrusive posture; blends into background
Standard Academy uniform; modest styling
Often positioned at edge of group shots
Carries stealth/concealment talismans
Calm, watchful expression

behavioral_anchors.anchor: Speech: soft-spoken, precise; speaks only when needed
Emotional range: dependable; quietly anxious; loyal
Verbal tic: hesitant agreement; reliable follow-through

characters.name: Hokuto
characters.role: Natsume's shikigami (girl form); medium to be near Harutora. Vol.2 opens 'parted with Hokuto'.

visual_anchors.anchor: Girl-form shikigami; bright, energetic design
Tied to Natsume's memories of Harutora
Associated with the red ribbon Harutora keeps
Name shared with a dragon shikigami (INFERRED)
Absent/passed at Vol.2 open — shown via memory/flashback only

behavioral_anchors.anchor: Speech: cheerful, teasing; pushes Harutora to become an onmyo mage
Emotional range: warm, encouraging; the emotional catalyst for Harutora's promise
Verbal tic: playful challenges; 'I'll take care of the ribbon'

qc.anchor_count_check: All 8 characters meet >=5 visual + >=3 behavioral anchors.
qc.voice_consistency: Behavioral anchors reference characters_db for all downstream Dialogue Writer (Stage 8) and Voice Script (Stage 14).
